parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about a strange event related to crime. For questions 1 to 7, decide if the sentences are true of false. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: A man in a batman costume brought an offender into justice.
The offender is accused of dealing with stolen property and committing fraud.
Police think they know who this Batman is.
The man in the batman costume went away in a fast car.
People are trying to find out who this Batman was.
It seems that Batman and the offender know each other.
